text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Aug 16 editions of Russian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Georgian President Eduard Shevardnadze and separatist Abkhaz leader Vladislav Ardzinba have signed an agreement banishing use of military force in settling disputes
- Pentagon is exerting pressure on Sofia to make it part with a secret Russian-made air-defence system deployed in Bulgaria in 1984.
- Rebel Tajik military commander Makhmud Khudoyberdyev has refused to give up his arms to government troops.

- The appointment of director general of Russian Interfax news agency Mikhail Komissar to the post of deputy head of President Yeltsin's administration indicates the Russian leadership is willing to pay more attention to public relations.
- The Interior Ministry and the Justice Ministry continue their tug-of-war over who will control Russian penitentiary system.
- Russian civil aviation security standards are in sharp decline.
- Two Russian cosmonauts who returned to Earth on Thursday will now come under close scrutiny of a special commission investigating the hitches and mishaps which dogged the 186-day mission.
- Tokyo is working to improve its political relations with Moscow in order not to be outdone by other countries at the share-up of Russia's economic pie.
- The appointment of Maxim Boiko head of the State Property Committee does not mean the fundamentals of privatisation will change, says First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais.
- The crew of the Mir station just returned from space will have to give account of all the accidents that happened aboard the run-down spacecraft during their mission.

- Commercial banks in charge of handling budget funds most often carry out their duties with care and the decision to transfer state funds to the central bank appears to be mainly of political nature, says Deputy Chairman of the Bank of Russia Alexander Khandruyev.
- Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin has praised his government on having worked out a viable 1998 draft budget.
- Rebel Tajik commander Khudoyberdyev seems to be alienated by all major political forces in the troubled republic.
